content.text: About the Million Veteran Program MVP makes discoveries that matter to Veterans MVP makes discoveries that matter to VeteransMental health: We're working to find earlier and better preventions and treatments for PTSD, depression, anxiety, and suicideHeart health: We’re studying what puts people at risk—and what protects people—from different kinds of heart diseasesCancer: We’ve made advances in areas like breast cancer and prostate cancer, with more cancers studied every yearWellness: We're finding ways for Veterans to live healthier lives through nutrition and lifestyle choicesAnd more: We’re studying dozens of health conditions that matter to Veterans, including diabetes, Alzheimer’s disease, endometriosis, osteoarthritis, and impacts of military exposures. Visit our Science Corner to learn more. The power of health research The power of health research"My investment in research isn't necessarily just for me or my friends that served—it's for my son, who could possibly be the one serving next."—Ubon Mendie, Marine Corps and Army VeteranHelp ensure people like you are represented in health research. Groundbreaking discoveries in diverse populations Groundbreaking discoveries in diverse populationsWe aim to improve Veteran health care for all, a goal that is achievable thanks to the participation of Veterans from all backgrounds. 25% of MVP participants come from minority racial and ethnic backgrounds, and MVP has the largest cohort of Black participants of any research program in the world. A commitment to women Veterans A commitment to women VeteransWomen Veterans deserve specialized care. At MVP, this starts with specialized research. We’re studying conditions that affect women including breast cancer, endometriosis, osteoarthritis, heart disease, and more. Over 100,000 women Veterans are part of MVP. Make a difference for Veteran health care Make a difference for Veteran health careMVP is stronger when it includes all Veterans. Join over 1 million Veterans in our mission to build a healthier tomorrow. Get involved Get InvolvedShare information about MVP with Veterans in your network. Download shareable resources, including social media content, brochures, factsheets, posters, and more.
